title: BMO Directs a Movie
synopsis: BMO writes, directs, and stars in a feature film, and nobody involved knows what it is about, including BMO.
plot:
BMO announces the production of 'BMO Presents: The Movie', a sweeping epic shot on BMO's own camera. Finn is cast as the hero, Jake as the villain, and LSP as 'the drama'. The script is four pages long and mostly stage directions like 'Finn feels something' and 'a horse (Jake)'.

Shooting is chaos. Jake refuses to be a villain and plays the role as a misunderstood baker. LSP rewrites her lines every take. Ice King, not cast, keeps walking into shots and BMO keeps him in. Tree Trunks caters. Shelby is the boom mic. Finn tries his hardest and delivers every line with total sincerity, even 'the sky is a hat'.

The premiere is held on a bedsheet in the Grass Lands. The film is forty minutes long, makes no sense, and every single person in the audience cries at the ending, in which Finn and the horse (Jake) sit on a hill and BMO says, in voiceover, 'and that's what a family is'. LSP demands a sequel. BMO is already writing it.
transcriptText:
BMO: Attention, everyone! BMO is making a movie. It will be called 'BMO Presents: The Movie'.
Finn: What's it about?
BMO: It is about everything, Finn.
Jake: Can I see the script?
BMO: [handing over four pages] Do not lose it. It is the only one.
Jake: [reading] 'Scene one. Finn feels something. A horse (Jake).' That's it? That's the scene?
BMO: It is a very rich scene.
Lumpy Space Princess: Who am I playing?
BMO: You are the drama.
Lumpy Space Princess: Finally, some RANGE.
[Shooting. Jake in a villain cape, holding a rolling pin.]
BMO: And... action!
Jake: I'm not evil. I'm just a baker nobody understood.
BMO: Cut! Jake, you are the villain.
Jake: Nobody's the villain in their own story, BMO.
BMO: ...That is very good. Keep it. Action!
[Ice King wanders into the shot.]
Ice King: Oh! Sorry! Is this a movie? Am I in it?
BMO: You are now. Keep going.
Ice King: What's my motivation?
BMO: Confusion.
Ice King: I can do that!
Finn: [with total sincerity] The sky... is a hat.
BMO: [wiping a tear] Beautiful. Cut.
Shelby: [holding a stick with a sock on it] Am I doing the boom right?
BMO: You are perfect, Shelby.
[The premiere. A bedsheet screen. The final scene: Finn and Jake on a hill.]
BMO: [voiceover] And that's what a family is.
[The credits roll. Silence. Then sniffling.]
Tree Trunks: [sobbing] Oh, that horse.
Ice King: [sobbing] I was so confused and it MEANT something.
Lumpy Space Princess: [sobbing] I need a sequel. I NEED it.
BMO: [already typing] Scene one. Finn feels something else.
